_comment: Which family a board actually runs. Getting this wrong writes one firmware at a board expecting another - a cartographer probe flashed with upstream klipper, or judged against a source tree it was never built from - so every step from reading the key to acting on it is guarded.

mutations.name: a type runs the family its section names
the declared firmware is kept, not discarded on load
a family nobody declared is refused rather than accepted
a non-default firmware survives a save
katapult is still listed for a board that has it
mutations.find:
if self.katapult_installed and firmware.BOOTLOADER not in out:
            out.append(firmware.BOOTLOADER)
